name: Core Defender
summary:
# DEFEND THE CORE. FIGHT FOR YOUR GALAXY.
Welcome to **Core Defender**, a thrilling, immersive VR action-defense experience built from the ground up for Meta Quest.

The energy core is all that stands between your galaxy and total annihilation. As the appointed Core Defender, it’s your job to hold the line. Waves of ruthless enemies are coming, and they won’t stop until the core is destroyed. Do you have what it takes to survive?
